profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading as GEHC. On its website, the company describes itself as providing digital infrastructure, data analytics and decision support tools that help in diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of patients. It says its vision is precise, personal and connected healthcare, and that it builds integrated solutions for hospitals and healthcare systems.

The company states that it has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and that it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It describes its work as helping transform how hospitals and healthcare systems operate and empowering clinicians to make therapies more accurate and effective. No specific AI product names are given in the available material.

Public records list the company as a for-profit public company with SEC CIK number 0001932393 and ticker GEHC. It is also listed under the alias GE HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY. The company appears in 374 Illinois court records.
